title: Interpretable Cutting Plane Selection for Mixed-Integer Linear Programming Using Genetic Programming
abstract: arXiv:2610.29311v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Cutting planes (cuts) remove fractional solutions from mixed-integer linear programs (MILPs) without excluding any feasible integer solutions, making them a key ingredient in modern MILP solvers. Current state-of-the-art solvers rely on fine-tuned handcrafted cut strategies, which, despite their effectiveness, remain inherently static and can be suboptimal. More recently, learning-based approaches have been proposed to design adaptive cut strategies; however, most of these methods are based on neural networks, offering limited interpretability and providing no guarantees of convergence. In this paper, we propose \emph{Genetic Programming and Statistics-based Cut Selection} (GPSCS), the first learning-based framework that explicitly generalizes handcrafted cut selection heuristics into a fully interpretable policy. translated_abstract: 割平面能够在不排除任何可行整数解的前提下，从混合整数线性规划（MILP）中移除分数解，因而是现代MILP求解器的关键组成部分。当前最先进的求解器依赖于经过精细调优的手工割平面策略，尽管这些策略行之有效，但本质上仍是静态的，可能并非最优。近年来，已有基于学习的方法被提出用于设计自适应割平面策略；然而，这些方法大多基于神经网络，可解释性有限，且无法提供收敛性保证。在本文中，我们提出了基于遗传规划与统计的割平面选择方法（GPSCS），这是首个将手工割平面选择启发式规则显式泛化为完全可解释策略的基于学习的框架。首先，遗传规划模型演化出一个符号化评分函数，利用从（摘要在此处被截断）
tldr: 本文提出首个基于遗传规划的完全可解释割平面选择框架GPSCS，通过演化符号化评分函数将手工启发式策略显式泛化为可解释的自适应割平面选择策略，弥补了神经网络方法可解释性差且缺乏收敛保证的不足。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes GPSCS, the first learning-based framework for fully interpretable cut selection in MILP solvers, which uses genetic programming to evolve a symbolic scoring function that explicitly generalizes handcrafted cut selection heuristics into an adaptive, interpretable policy, addressing the limited interpretability and lack of convergence guarantees of neural network-based approaches.
